tournaments.summary: The ICC Champions Trophy 2025 will be hosted in Pakistan, featuring the top eight ODI teams in a round-robin format.
The Asia Cup 2025 will feature top teams from the Asian Cricket Council, hosted in UAE, following a T20I format.
The ICC Women's World Cup 2025 will feature 31 ODIs played across various venues in India.

tournaments.tournament_name: 2025 Women's T20 World Cup Asia Qualifier
tournaments.summary: The 2025 Women's T20 World Cup Asia Qualifier was a cricket tournament that formed part of the qualification process for the 2026 Women's T20 World Cup, hosted by Thailand.
